svg.text: Private Foundry hosted agent published to Microsoft Teams (no APIM)
Teams traffic uses Foundry's source-IP-filtered public Activity route, not Private Link. All other Foundry APIs stay private.
The user chats with the published agent in Teams.
Bot Service calls Foundry's public Activity Protocol route, filtered to Bot Service / M365
source IPs (enable_m365_public_endpoint) and authorized with BotServiceRbac.
The hosted agent calls the model; traces reach Application Insights privately.
From the devbox, notebook 3 deploys, tests and publishes through the private endpoint.
Your local VS Code connects to the devbox with Remote-SSH.
Direct calls from outside the VNet are rejected: public network access is disabled.
